text: Opus review175 of4fe0fe4ee: provider edge ordinals now follow first appearance rather than lexicographic pairs. SurfaceGeodesics.scala:239-244 checks custom weights only by length, so external arrays built in old order could silently attach weights to wrong edges. README documents the new order; in-repo callers/tests map correctly. Follow up with explicit migration guidance or edge/domain-indexed weight API while moving consumers. Persistent scene/MVPA/atlas identity goldens remain unchanged.
